# MTT Packaging
> High-end custom packaging for premium brands, corporate gifting and product projects, personally handled by Hugo He.

## Contact
- Brand: MTT Packaging
- Consultant: Hugo He
- Website: https://mttpackaging.com
- Email: alexanderhe1212@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: +86 17207110964

## Core services
- Premium rigid boxes: magnetic, lift-off lid, drawer and presentation structures.
- Corporate gift packaging for campaigns, events and business relationships.
- Premium folding cartons with specialty papers, printing and finishes.
- Bespoke branded paper bags.
- Custom inserts in paper, molded pulp, EVA and fabric-covered materials.

## Materials and finishes
- Materials: rigid greyboard, specialty paper, paperboard and corrugated board.
- Finishes: foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, textured paper and controlled color matching.
- Protection: paper, molded pulp, EVA and fabric-covered inserts designed around the product.

## Service area
MTT Packaging supports custom packaging projects for brands and business buyers worldwide. Hugo He is the direct sales and project contact.

## Quotation requirements
Provide finished internal dimensions in L × W × H, structure, order quantity, artwork or print colors, finishes, insert material, delivery country and target budget. Photos alone are not production specifications.

## Production
Physical sampling and artwork approval are recommended before mass production. Typical custom projects start from 500–1,000 pieces, depending on structure and process.
